## Purpose

Operator-run, one-off maintenance scripts â€” data migration, forensic audit, build-time asset
generation, and test-environment seeding. They are never imported by the application runtime, but
may be invoked deliberately by an operator, an explicit deployment gate, or CI; their caller and
side-effect boundary must therefore be documented per script.

## Shape

- [backend/scripts/audit_lost_run_events.py](../../backend/scripts/audit_lost_run_events.py) â€” strictly read-only forensic audit (opens
  SQLite with a `mode=ro` URI, issues only SELECTs) that re-simulates the pre-FIX-240 seq
  allocator to name which `run_events` rows a historical seq-collision destroyed. Reports
  `WALKED-ONTO` losses and `ORPHAN-CARD` tombstones; explicitly refuses to ever become a
  repair path, because a back-filled row would mint an `event_id` the engine never emitted.

- [backend/scripts/cutover_legacy_runs.py](../../backend/scripts/cutover_legacy_runs.py) â€” one-time deployment-window script (T021b) that
  cancels any non-terminal `WorkflowRun` created by the pre-Universal-Execution-Engine legacy
  runners (identified by a missing `pipeline_run_id`), run once before deleting those legacy
  runner files. Supports `--dry-run`.

- [backend/scripts/generate_template_thumbnails.py](../../backend/scripts/generate_template_thumbnails.py) â€” build-time step that screenshots each
  `design-templates/<id>/example.html` via headless Chromium (Playwright) at 1280x720 and
  writes `thumbnail.jpg`, baked into the backend Docker image build. Best-effort by design
  (always exits 0); templates without a thumbnail fall back to a live `<iframe>` in the
  catalog UI.

- [backend/scripts/seed_test_users.py](../../backend/scripts/seed_test_users.py) â€” idempotently provisions one QA user per tier through
  Cognito (`AdminCreateUser`, temporary-password set, and group membership) and reconciles the
  local ownership projection. It no longer seeds a local password-hash credential path.
- [backend/scripts/migrate_local_users_to_cognito.py](../../backend/scripts/migrate_local_users_to_cognito.py) â€” pre-0038 report/link/invite utility,
  dry-run by default. The committed deployment gate invokes its read-only report with
  `--fail-on-unlinked` before migrations; link operations write both the Cognito subject and the
  legacy cutover marker while that column still exists, and refuse rebinding a different subject.
- [backend/scripts/verify_cognito_cutover.py](../../backend/scripts/verify_cognito_cutover.py) â€” read-only verification of the cutover schema,
  user mapping, migration head, and provider/group round-trips after the Cognito-only deployment.

## Why this shape

These are deliberately kept as standalone scripts rather than app-layer endpoints or
management commands: each does something an admin does rarely and consciously â€” repair a
stuck deployment, prove a historical data loss, warm a build artifact, or bootstrap test
fixtures â€” and **none should be reachable over HTTP or triggered by a request**.

Several import directly from `app.models`/`agents.execution_engine` by inserting `backend/`
onto `sys.path`, since they run outside the FastAPI app context. The audit script enforces
its read-only contract at the connection level (SQLite `mode=ro`) **rather than by convention
alone**.

This directory still holds no reusable runtime library surface, but it is no longer exclusively
human-triggered: deployment invokes the committed read-only Cognito-link gate and CI has isolated
support utilities here. Scheduled reconciliation lives under `app/scripts`, keeping the
container-deployed operational surface separate from standalone repository tooling.
